result.title: Joint friction and dynamics, Unitree H1 elbow test stand
result.system: Unitree H1 elbow actuator on the Anchor-Lab test stand
result.quantity: elbow_tau (actuator torque estimate, N*m), on a uniform 2 ms grid
result.baseline: B0: rigid joint without friction, tau = J ddq + g1 sin q + g2 cos q + tau0
result.model: MotionProof joint friction: B0 + c dq + Fc tanh(dq / 0.02 rad/s) (viscous damping plus smoothed Coulomb friction, as the drive model's damping and frictionloss)
result.acceptance: validation RMSE(model) <= 0.8 x validation RMSE(B0) and validation NRMSE(model) <= 0.35

split.identification: 36 sine trials (0.5/1.0/1.5 Hz x small/medium/large) at stand positions 8, 9 and 10
split.validation: the 12 sine trials at stand position 11 (whole trials, never mixed)

result.scope: external system; says nothing about the MotionProof reference gearbox or user hardware

model.note: standard errors assume independent residuals and are optimistic for time series

baseline.note: standard errors assume independent residuals and are optimistic for time series

transformations: q, dq, tau linearly interpolated onto a common uniform 2 ms grid inside the shared time span (no extrapolation)
ddq: Savitzky-Golay derivative of dq (21 samples, cubic)
25 samples trimmed at each end (derivative edge effects)
